issues: 全片是灰阶占位：SUBJECT / CONTENT / 1234 / EXPLANATION / SUPPORTING DETAIL，图解讲不出任何东西
开场全屏内容场是一块平涂中灰，圆窗收束时没有'沉浸特写'的质感
480×270 设计坐标放大，外环是粗虚线、箭头细小，结构读不清
右栏标题是四个小色块 + 小字说明，字号远低于可读线，最终帧不成海报
changes: look 换 midnight，讲一件真东西：虚构紧凑型聚变试验堆 Ardent-1 的磁约束——主体是等离子体（白热核心 + 环形等离子带 + 两层反向旋转的 feTurbulence 湍流丝缕）
开场等离子体 3.6× 铺满整屏，圆窗 1150→230px 收束的同时等离子体 3.6→1 拉远（两层速度不同 → 纵深），落定后圆窗边缘亮起青色轮廓光
机制三层几何按 1920 原生坐标重做：r290 细环 + 72 道刻度 3.8→1；24 块超导线圈顺时针逐块'咔'入位、内沿被等离子体照亮，整环匀速慢转；12 支向心箭头线端与箭头头同步长出，落定时等离子体被'挤'一下
让位：整组共用一个 transform 左移 360px、缩到 0.8（swift）；右栏 112px 大标题「Twelve coils. / One star.」四个词块错峰 3f 升起，star. 用白→青→电光蓝渐变
青色注释条 ARDENT-1 | COMPACT FUSION PILOT 自左裁切揭出，38px 二级说明两行落入；尾段只剩外环慢转，时长 190→200f
issuesEn: The whole shot was gray placeholders — SUBJECT / CONTENT / 1234 / EXPLANATION / SUPPORTING DETAIL — so the diagram explained nothing
The full-screen opening field was flat mid-gray, so the aperture collapse had no immersive close-up feel
Scaled up from 480×270 design coordinates: the outer ring was a coarse dashed line and the arrows were tiny, so the structure was hard to read
The right column was four small color tiles and small captions far below legibility; the final frame was not a poster
changesEn: Look switched to midnight and the diagram explains something real: magnetic confinement in a fictional compact fusion pilot, Ardent-1 — the subject is plasma (white-hot core, toroidal band, two counter-rotating feTurbulence wisps)
Plasma fills the screen at 3.6× at the open; as the aperture closes 1150→230px the plasma pulls back 3.6→1 at a different speed for depth, and a cyan rim lights up when it settles

Three mechanism layers rebuilt at native 1920 scale: a r290 ring with 72 ticks scales 3.8→1; 24 superconducting coils click in clockwise with plasma-lit inner rims and rotate slowly as one ring; 12 inward arrows grow with tip and shaft in sync, and the plasma gets squeezed as they land

Make-way move: the whole group shares one transform, sliding 360px left and scaling to 0.8 (swift); the right column's 112px headline 'Twelve coils. / One star.' rises as four word blocks 3f apart, 'star.' in a white→cyan→electric-blue gradient
A cyan annotation bar 'ARDENT-1 | COMPACT FUSION PILOT' clip-reveals from the left and a 38px two-line explanation drops in; only the outer ring keeps turning in the tail; 190→200f
